subtopics.title: Redox as Electron Transfer — Agents and Their Names

questions.question: OIL RIG stands for:
options: Oxidation is loss of electrons, reduction is gain of electrons
Oxidation is low, reduction is great
Oxygen is lost, reduction involves gas
Oxidation increases lightness, reduction increases gravity

questions.question: In Zn + Cu²⁺ → Zn²⁺ + Cu, the zinc is:
options: Reduced, because it forms a positive ion
Oxidised, because it loses two electrons as its oxidation number rises from 0 to +2
Unchanged, because it stays a metal

questions.question: The oxidising agent in a redox reaction is the species that:
options: Takes electrons from its partner and is itself reduced

questions.question: In the combustion CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O, carbon's oxidation number changes from:
The half-reactions in the table of standard reduction potentials are all written as:
options: Reductions — ion plus electrons giving the element

questions.question: Before adding two half-reactions, you must first:
options: Multiply them so both involve the same number of electrons

questions.question: Combining Al → Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ with Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu gives the balanced equation:
A correctly balanced final redox equation must:
options: Show no loose electrons, with atoms and total charge balanced on both sides
Show the electrons on the product side
Have equal numbers of ions on both sides

questions.question: Preparing potassium nitrate requires:

questions.question: Calcium chloride must be CaCl₂ because:

subtopics.title: Electron Bookkeeping — Every Atom Gets an Account

questions.question: The rule that lets you solve for an unknown oxidation number is:
options: Every atom must equal its group number
The largest atom takes the charge
The balances in a neutral compound must sum to zero

questions.question: Carbon swings from −4 in methane to +4 in carbon dioxide. This tells you that combustion:
options: Moved a substantial number of electrons — it is a redox reaction

questions.question: An account balance that goes UP during a reaction means the atom:
Hydrogen's oxidation number is −1 only when it is:
options: Bonded to a metal in a hydride

subtopics.title: Coins Change Pockets — and the Trade Must Balance

questions.question: In the coin picture, oxidation is:
Oxidation and reduction always occur together because:
options: Every electron paid by one species is collected by another

questions.question: "The pickpocket is named by the victim's loss" means the oxidising agent:
options: Is the species that loses electrons
Causes the other species to be oxidised, and is itself reduced

questions.question: Aluminium pays electrons in threes and copper ions collect in twos, so a clean trade needs:
options: Two aluminiums and three coppers — six electrons each way
